note: Bài nghe bổ sung cho Tiếng Anh 6 - Unit 3 (Global Success).

questions.audio_text: A: Who is that girl, Nam? B: She is my best friend, Thu. She is tall and slim with long black hair. A: She looks very friendly. B: Yes, she always smiles and she is very kind to everyone.
questions.explain: Câu 1: Thu cao và mảnh khảnh ('tall and slim'). Câu 2: tóc đen dài ('long black hair').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: A. She is tall and slim
B. She is short and slim
C. She is tall and strong
D. She is short and fat

questions.audio_text: A: What does your friend Minh look like? B: He is short with curly hair and round glasses. A: What is he like? B: He is very funny. He always tells jokes and makes us laugh. A: Does he like sports? B: Yes, he plays football very well.
questions.explain: Câu 1: Minh tóc xoăn ('curly hair'). Câu 2: Minh hài hước, hay kể chuyện cười ('very funny... tells jokes').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

questions.audio_text: A: Do you and your best friend have the same hobbies? B: Yes and no. We both love reading comic books, but I like playing chess and she likes dancing. A: What do you usually do together at weekends? B: We often go to the bookstore near our school, then have bubble tea together.
questions.explain: Câu 1: cả hai đều thích đọc truyện tranh ('both love reading comic books'). Câu 2: cuối tuần thường đi hiệu sách ('go to the bookstore').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: What hobby do the two friends share?
What do they usually do together at weekends?

questions.audio_text: A: Tell me about your new friend, An. B: His name is Duc. He moved here from Da Nang last month. He is generous and hard-working. A: What does he look like? B: He is tall, with short hair and bright eyes. He wears glasses when he reads. A: He sounds nice!
questions.explain: Câu 1: Đức chuyển từ Đà Nẵng đến ('moved here from Da Nang'). Câu 2: Đức đeo kính khi đọc sách ('wears glasses when he reads').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: B. From Ho Chi Minh City

questions.audio_text: A: I had a small argument with my best friend yesterday. B: Oh no! What happened? A: We both wanted the last comic book in the shop. I was angry and said something unkind. B: What did you do then? A: In the evening, I called her and said sorry. She forgave me, and now we are good friends again. B: That was the right thing to do.
questions.explain: Câu 1: cãi nhau vì cả hai đều muốn cuốn truyện tranh cuối cùng ('both wanted the last comic book'). Câu 2: tối đó gọi điện xin lỗi ('called her and said sorry').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

options: A. They wanted the same seat
B. They both wanted the last comic book
sub_questions.q: Why did the two friends argue?

options: A. She bought another comic book
B. She waited for a week
C. She called and said sorry in the evening
D. She asked the teacher for help
sub_questions.q: How did the speaker solve the problem?

questions.audio_text: A: Who do you admire most, Linh? B: I admire my elder sister. She is not only beautiful but also very brave. Last year, she saved a small boy from a deep pond. A: Wow, she is a hero! What is she doing now? B: She is studying to become a doctor so she can help more people.
questions.explain: Câu 1: chị gái dũng cảm ('very brave'), từng cứu một cậu bé khỏi ao sâu. Câu 2: chị đang học để trở thành bác sĩ ('studying to become a doctor').
questions.q: Nghe đoạn hội thoại và trả lời câu hỏi

sub_questions.q: What does her sister want to become?
